name: Discrete Volume Transmittance Integration
definition: Computes the total extinction (optical depth) along a ray segment by summing the extinction coefficient at discrete sample points, then exponentiating the negative sum to obtain transmittance.
summary: Discrete Volume Transmittance Integration computes light survival in participating media by numerically integrating extinction via fixed-step sampling, distinguishing itself from analytic methods by handling heterogeneous media without closed-form solutions.
